code_patches.name: オート図鑑: 「Press A to show all N」を文単位にして翻訳できるように
code_patches.replace: Detail = $"{group.Detail}{(group.Detail.EndsWith('.') ? "" : ".")} " + (open ? (group.Steps.Count == 1 ? "Press A to hide it." : $"Press A to hide all {group.Steps.Count}.") : (group.Steps.Count == 1 ? "Press A to show it." : $"Press A to show all {group.Steps.Count}.")),
